youtube.title: Cope put the dinosaur's head on its TAIL 🦕 #shorts
youtube.caption:
The Bone Wars started because one paleontologist put a skull on the wrong end. 🦕💀

Cope built his new sea monster. Marsh noticed the head was on the tail.

Whose fail is worse, Cope's or Marsh's? 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on 1870: Edward Drinker Cope's Elasmosaurus was reconstructed with its head on the tail, Marsh gleefully pointed it out, and Cope tried to buy up every copy of the journal. Marsh's own Brontosaurus later turned out to have the wrong skull.

#bonewars #paleontology #dinosaur #fossils #brontosaurus #historymemes #funnyhistory #shorts
